Roof Repair, Replacement and Re-Roofing in Fort Myers Roofs work hard in Southwest Florida. Relentless sun, summer downpours, salt air near the coast and the odd tropical system all wear a roof down, so most homeowners land here for one of a few reasons: a fresh leak, storm damage, or an ageing roof that finally needs a plan. Whether the right answer is an asphalt shingle roof, a barrel tile roof, a standing-seam metal roof or a flat membrane over a lanai, we help you weigh the options and reach a roofing contractor who can quote the job properly. Roof Replacement Full tear-off and re-roof for shingle, tile and metal homes across Fort Myers and Lee County, from the decking and underlayment up to a finished, code-compliant covering. View service -> Roof Repair Targeted repairs for leaks, missing shingles, cracked tiles and worn flashing, scoped to the damage found on a real inspection rather than an over-sold replacement. View service -> Shingle Roofing Asphalt shingle repair and replacement, the most common roof in Fort Myers, with attention to ventilation and the heat and storm exposure that shortens shingle life in Southwest Florida. View service -> Tile Roofing Concrete and clay tile repair, re-bedding and replacement for the barrel-tile roofs common on the stucco and Mediterranean-style homes around Fort Myers. View service -> Metal Roofing Standing-seam and metal panel roofing for Fort Myers homeowners who want a longer service life and strong wind performance under the Florida Building Code. View service -> Flat & Low-Slope Roofing TPO, EPDM and modified-bitumen work on additions, lanais and low-slope sections where a membrane system, not shingles, is the right fit. View service -> Storm Damage & Emergency Tarping Fast temporary tarping and leak control after storms to limit water entry, followed by a documented assessment for permanent repair and any homeowner's insurance claim. View service -> Roof Inspection Pre-sale, post-storm and periodic inspections that check shingles, flashing, decking and ventilation, and can support a wind mitigation report for your insurer. View service -> Why Fort Myers Homeowners Start Here A roof is one of the biggest calls a homeowner makes, and in Florida it carries real code and insurance weight. Here is what we keep front and centre so you can move ahead with confidence. Verify the license yourself Our network includes DBPR-registered Florida roofing contractors. You can check any license at MyFloridaLicense.com before a contractor sets foot on your roof. Built to Florida wind standards Lee County roofing has to meet the Florida Building Code's high-wind requirements, and the matched roofing contractor works to those standards on every job. Written scope and price The roofing contractor puts scope, price and terms in writing before work starts. Any number discussed earlier is only a guide until then. Local Lee County coverage We help homeowners right across Fort Myers and Lee County, from McGregor and Whiskey Creek to Cape Coral, Lehigh Acres, Estero and Fort Myers Beach. Get help with your Fort Myers roof Tell us what is going on, whether that is a leak you have just found, damage after a storm, or a roof you already know is near the end of its life. We will help you understand the options, and an independent Florida roofing contractor takes it from there to inspect and quote the work. No pressure and no obligation. Any figure raised early is a guide only, until a contractor has walked the roof and put a firm price in writing. Roofing questions Fort Myers homeowners ask Straight answers on cost, repair versus replacement, permits and finding a licensed roofer. How much does a new roof cost in Fort Myers? A new roof in Fort Myers turns on the roof size, pitch, material and whether the decking or flashing also needs work. As a market guide only, asphalt shingle replacement in the area is commonly quoted around $4.50 to $8.00 per square foot, with tile and metal higher. Treat that as indicative, not a quote.
